comment: Provenance for the restored xhtml1 variant of the vendored 2011-03-23 official suite. The variant is the XHTML build of the same pre-snapshot sources that produced the vendored html4 tree; every document is pinned to its csswg-test blob, and its XHTML->HTML build transform reproduces the vendored html4 twin byte for byte (recorded per file). Regenerate with scripts/restore-css21-xhtml1.py.

restoredFrom.csswgTestHistory: csswg-test@fa44870087 (arronei fork; last commit before the 2011-03-23 snapshot)
restoredFrom.build: tools/pub-css21.pl -> tools/build-css21.py -> tools/CSSTestLib (OutputFormats.XHTMLFormat/HTMLFormat and the patched html5lib serializer) at the same commit
restoredFrom.gold: the vendored html4/ build of the same sources (Wayback capture)
